title: Archive H25 cache sources and remaining N22, P07 and P02 work
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Publishes an archival source-and-review handoff for the three remaining H25 cache candidates: N22, P07 and P02. The package preserves 111 exact source/review files as inert snapshots, with a path/hash manifest and two independently claimable contribution tasks.

The N22/P07 local protocol and P02 local protocol have bounded independent agent source acceptance. P02's corrected dual-reference bridge design is accepted, but its bridge implementation remains outstanding. The G12 parent/consumer integration is explicitly **rejected** on an identity tuple/dictionary mismatch and first-error/descriptor-cleanup defects; the remaining source review is incomplete. Rejected code is included only as a repair starting point, not an accepted executable component.

The broader historical source-review evidence is outside this curated export and has not been replayed here. No new candidate acceptance, complete adoption, runtime/caller qualification, performance gain, kappa improvement or selected-frontier change is claimed. Original source work remains paused and these tasks are released for external contribution.

## Task and overlap

Originating benchmark or verification contribution: [PR #6029](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6029).

Explicit user-assigned continuation and contribution handoff; no new task was drawn. Base: 2485805a6d47f36ea83ddde6327d453ac82d44dc. Head: ca9d90e93dc495e1e5e5ef6d271ff1e4f089cd0c. Tree: 561c23bddd935b87b99464c98d39e1c02084add2.

Only research/h25-cache-source-handoff is added (117 files, 4,378,685 bytes). Scope is refined from runtime optimization to preserving source components and requesting independent completion. The common frozen predecessor is PR6029 at e05aad954689d0ee21baff19b4674f1fcb2e838f. Independently usable bounded-log and lossless-archive packages already exist in #6316 and #6317; neither is duplicated or a dependency. Fresh PR search for P02 returned no matches; h25/cache search surfaced earlier #5908 and #5972 among historical unrelated results. That bounded search is not a novelty claim.

## Validation

```sh
cd research/h25-cache-source-handoff
sha256sum -c CHECKSUMS.sha256
```

Metadata-only preparation checked every copied byte/hash against its frozen original, all selected JSON documents, 53 direct G12-freeze/P02-source-pin references, 19 relative document links and the isolated added-file inventory. The public Git tree equals the locally checked tree. Original whitespace, earlier failed versions and review rejections remain preserved. Code has an additional .txt suffix; contents are unchanged.

This command checks archive integrity only; runtime is host dependent and no performance result is claimed. No target source import, helper, compiler, native/scientific run or decoder was executed for publication. No runtime replay is registered. The reference index explicitly marks other historical/out-of-scope dependencies outside this curated export. Reconstruct the relevant full closure before integration. The original local policy usage is 63.770533479/2400 seconds; complete physical costs and final metadata-publication tail remain unknown, not zero. The allowance is historical and not transferable to contributors. Hosted checks are pending at submission.

## Credit

Chris R / Clear1nsight, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Exact source preserves predecessor, native, circuit/network and reviewer attribution, including Douglas R. Colkitt and the PR6029 lineage. Apache-2.0. Independent agent source reviews do not establish independent human or formal proof-kernel acceptance.

## Open next questions

Please claim work in this PR conversation with your exact branch/head, files and bounded scope. See CONTRIBUTOR-TASKS.md:

1. **G12 / N22 and P07:** repair the two known defects in a new successor, preserve first-primary and complete cleanup, then complete independent source review of the remaining branches and integration. Coordinate these two candidates under one owner.
2. **P02:** implement the accepted v4 parent/adapter/consumer/driver bridge, preserving both original reference runs and post-both-writer retention ordering, then obtain independent source review. This lane can proceed separately.
3. **Review:** independently review one exact frozen successor. Report established checks and unreviewed obligations; preserve original oracles, checks and full cost boundaries.

A focused repair or new concrete rejection is useful. Complete source adoption, actual execution, full-caller equality and measured gain remain separate obligations. Do not expand this source task into the extra accounting API already excluded by the scope clarification.
